Pentasyllabic tone analyzer

This tool always treats lines as five-character verse. It tests 2nd vs 5th character when the final character is 仄, 2nd vs 4th character when the rhyme/final character is 平, and the line-wide 2nd vs 4th contrast in both tone and 平仄.

Paste poems and run the analyzer.
-Deflected-final lines where 2nd and 5th characters contrast by tone
-Level-rhyme lines where 2nd and 4th characters contrast by tone
-All lines where 2nd and 4th characters contrast by tone
-All lines where 2nd and 4th characters contrast by 平仄
-Couplets with level rhyme where final characters contrast by tone
-Couplets with deflected rhyme where final characters contrast by tone
